description: Net present value and internal rate of return of 2-360 dated cash flows. NPV at a stated annual effective rate, Actual/365 Fixed day count as in spreadsheet XNPV. XIRR-style rate by a bracketed, bounded search that says when no rate exists, when several may exist or when it did not converge. Arithmetic only: no currency conversion, tax rule or financial advice.

discount_rate.description: Annual effective rate as a fraction (0.08 for 8 %). Omit to skip the NPV.

amount.description: Signed amount in one currency: negative paid out, positive received.
